notes.title: Beyond the City VR V0.2 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27746779/1c6c95dd4e02ce0e91c3dce769d3aac36c170fa6.jpg[/img]
[b] Update log[/b]
Version 0.2

As promised, we are focused on our community feedback. Between collecting player feedback, sorting out numerous bug reports and other launch issues, it is safe to say that none of us had much sleep last night. Patch 0.2 fixes many of the issues that were reported over the past several days. Without extensive feedback it would have taken us a lot longer to track down and isolate the cause of many of these problems. This is exactly the communication that we’ve wanted.

[b] Highlights:[/b]
Enable the game language function: English translation version.

Tutorial added:
We added a new checkpoint of tutorial guide for the player: In order to make the it more friendly for player to get started, players can familiar with all the basic operation of the game.

New features: enable turret operation

[b]Comprehensive update:[/b]

· Increased interaction with map objects (stone, wooden box).
·Optimize the operation of the bows and arrows, and now players can make arrows farther and easier to hit the enemy.
·Optimize the operation of the staff
·Increased Arcane missile damage curve, and it can cause more damage if you hold down the trigger.
·Optimize the the HP volume of the city, and players can see it on the tower
·Increase /Replace some special visual effects.

[b]Balanced update:[/b]

Reduce the number of enemies per wave. Now players have more time to attack the special enemies.
Reduce the speed of movement of the enemy.
Increased the blood of the swordsman series enemies and magnified their volume.
The addition of the magician series of enemy effects, and now they are more prominent.
Adjust the magician to open the shield method.
Adjust the damage value of the defensive tower.
Adjust the player's attack damage.

Best Regards.
Beyond the City VR team.
